plugins.microphonePermission: MyLanguageTutor uses the microphone while you tap to speak, so you can answer the tutor out loud. It listens only until you stop talking.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Your iPhone turns what you say into text so the tutor can read it. It does this on the iPhone when it can for the language you're practicing; otherwise Apple does it. MyLanguageTutor never receives your audio.

plugins.faceIDPermission: I use Face ID to confirm it's you before changing your sign-in security.
